name: primary_raw_suite
description: Gate 1: Raw validation of the primary source (Policía Nacional - DIJIN domestic violence reports), evaluated on the extracted batch BEFORE any business transformation.

meta.data_object: Raw CSV batch data/raw/Reporte_Delito_Violencia_Intrafamiliar_*.csv (all columns read as text)

derived_evaluation_columns.CANTIDAD_NUMERIC: pd.to_numeric(CANTIDAD, errors='coerce'). Type cast used ONLY for evaluation; the raw batch is not modified.

meta.threshold_justification: Contractual: the 8 columns are the published schema of dataset vuyt-mqpw and every one feeds a dimension or the measure. A single missing column makes a dimension impossible to build, so no tolerance is allowed.

Analytical: a record whose date cannot be parsed has no id_tiempo, so it cannot be loaded without breaking the exact victim reconciliation (DQ-PREP-05). Any unparseable date is therefore a contract break, not noise.

Contractual (DIVIPOLA): the source publishes 8-digit centro-poblado codes; the municipal key is its first 5 digits. A code of any other length cannot be rolled up to a municipality and would silently break the integration key used by R6/R7.
CANTIDAD is the only additive measure. A non-numeric value would be coerced to null and drop victims from every KPI; zero tolerance protects the reconciliation invariant.
Business rule: a crime report registers at least one victim. A value <= 0 is semantically impossible and would reduce victim totals.

Analytical tolerance: nulls are imputed as 'NO REPORTADO' (no victims lost). With <= 1% unknown, the female share in R3 (77.3%) can move by at most ~1 percentage point, which does not change the conclusion. Above 1% the R3 KPI is no longer reliable, so the issue must be made visible. Historical baseline: 0.48%.
